one_line: Varman king who turned Kamarupa into a Brahmaputra valley power while drawing Davaka’s river kingdom into his orbit.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but strong build, about 5'9" with the poised stance of a thoughtful warrior-king.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown Assamese complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; default expression is calm, observant and mildly serious, as if weighing a decision.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair parted slightly off-centre, drawn back into a compact topknot at the back of the crown and tied with a narrow dark-red cloth band; no crown, but a simple thin gold circlet hugging the head just above the forehead, plain except for a tiny central round boss.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton tunic (kurta-like) with a subtle thin red border along the cuffs and hem, belted at the waist with a broad deep-maroon woven cloth sash; over his left shoulder is a light, unpatterned pale-yellow cotton uttariya (shawl) that drapes diagonally across the torso and falls behind; his lower garment is a wrapped dhoti of undyed cream cotton with a narrow woven red stripe along the edge, pleated neatly and reaching the ankles; on his feet are simple brown leather sandals with a single strap; jewellery is restrained—small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thick gold bangle on the right wrist, and a modest cylindrical gold amulet pendant on a cord; the textiles look handwoven and slightly textured, with no elaborate patterns.
appearance.signature: A medium-length straight iron sword with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade, a simple unadorned crossguard, a plain brown-wrapped grip, and a rounded pommel, carried sheathed in a dark-brown leather scabbard suspended from a plain brown belt on his left hip, which he rests his right hand on when thinking.

ref_desc: Kalyanavarman is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed, oval-faced early-30s king with a short beard, black hair in a small topknot with a thin gold circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, cream dhoti, pale-yellow shawl, maroon waist-sash, simple jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a plain iron sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Kalyanavarman: a medium-brown, sharp-eyed man in his early 30s with an oval face, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and calm, thoughtful expression; his thick black hair is pulled back into a small compact topknot tied with a narrow dark-red cloth band, and he wears a thin plain gold circlet just above the forehead. Show him in an off-white knee-length cotton tunic with a subtle thin red border at cuffs and hem, belted with a broad deep-maroon woven sash at the waist; a pale-yellow cotton uttariya (shawl) is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and back. His lower garment is a cream cotton dhoti with a narrow red edge stripe, pleated neatly to the ankles, and he wears simple brown leather sandals. Add small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thick gold bangle on the right wrist, and a modest cylindrical gold pendant on a cord. His signature weapon is a medium-length straight iron sword with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade, a simple crossguard, plain brown-wrapped grip, and rounded pommel, sheathed in a dark-brown leather scabbard on his left hip, which he lightly rests his hand on; keep colours to off-white, cream, deep maroon, pale yellow and brown, and present him front, side and back in consistent, clean anime lines.
